# Zar Media Group

> Zar Media Group (ZARMEDIAGROUP (PTY) LTD, CIPC 2026/166396/07) builds and manages secure client portals and websites for accountants, bookkeepers and financial service providers. Based in Cape Town, South Africa, serving firms across South Africa and abroad. Portals include secure document exchange, e-signatures, client intake and CRM/workflow integration (Xero, Sage, QuickBooks, DocuSign and more), designed with POPIA compliance in mind.

## Services

- [Client Portal & Document Vault](https://zarmediagroup.com/services/client-portal): Branded, POPIA-conscious client portal integrated into the firm's own website — secure document upload, e-signatures, progress tracking.
- [Website as a Service](https://zarmediagroup.com/services/website-as-a-service): Managed accounting firm websites — design, hosting, updates and portal kept in one subscription.
- [Workflow Integration](https://zarmediagroup.com/services/workflow-integration): Connecting portals with practice management and accounting tools (Xero, Sage, QuickBooks, HubSpot, TaxDome, Karbon).
- [Compliance & Trust](https://zarmediagroup.com/services/compliance-trust): POPIA, FSCA and FAIS-aware website and portal requirements for South African financial firms.

- [How to Reduce Admin in an Accounting Firm](https://zarmediagroup.com/resources/how-to-reduce-admin-accounting-firm): Workflow and portal automation.
